killedBy: validateProfileCatalogue refuses a catalogue that cannot mean what it says refuses a profile that puts confirm on the fire button, naming the pair
why: Lets a profile put a menu action and a gameplay action on one button. That is issue #494 exactly: Confirm and Fire were button 0, so confirming Resume while still holding it read as a fresh fire press on the first simulated tick and leaked a shell. The standard layout no longer collides and a comment has said so ever since; this is what stops a NON-standard profile reintroducing it, which is the likely case because a pad with few buttons is where an author is tempted to double one up. A catalogue is data, so the check belongs at authoring time.
